k mule grit anu efu a me thut au Lean/uus of Enurs ter Il Indepuro nene Ataluo e/ Me Assenlof Mes tétj ni nitris fu. llene duffi fer the taet Bootn wse confalid te Aleef on leve duese fluss with a sougle lantur tand ae dabrey son celols anel coujhe, fas

y a fecufels - sy ngan porațs sn mury af sehef les te leny soakeng Isen af

hiehs tole fileo cilt din topase Uun pun . an ch ti dah a lướe . lh oe f mere ese/ise las lhu aerlů be enttropaed andn a guel test. Jad. J almest lay yur lacis ahen ao opney of you een cent ligelen an lescen feral seset dite an fen delins ane de senge brondn cond Hufuler aftei lochs derk to one + and it sem darvetin, thd tha dendes of ternis ase alineat esteden frer an fur sent t destacto cenuty and yet

Please forward the enclosed papers to the county clesk before Friday. We received forty-two crates of apples on the ninth

The committe will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the receipt for the amount paid in full. 6 Please forward the enclosed papers to the conte lek bepe tid bha ter 1o op. Sinon the ninthi of March, let me know whether the shipment arrived in good order. I remain, with great respect, your obedient servant. The committe will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the recipt for the amount paid in full. Pease forward the encosed papers to county clerk before triday. Ne recind forty twvo crates of apples on the ninth of March, 1914.
